蓝牙断线后客户端应执行受限重连，并在连接状态变更后更新连接状态机，避免频繁扫描耗尽电量。
异分母分数相加时，先将分数通分为相同分母，再把分子相加；通分的依据是分数的基本性质。
MQTT 是一种基于发布订阅模式的消息协议，客户端向 broker 订阅主题，发布者向主题发送消息，broker 负责转发。
Android 8.0 之后系统对后台服务做了严格限制，建议使用 WorkManager 调度后台任务，并在不需要网络时延迟执行。
向量检索基于语义相似度召回，关键词检索基于词项精确匹配；两者常通过加权融合互补，向量负责同义改写，关键词负责精确名称。
一元二次方程 ax²+bx+c=0（a≠0）的求根公式为 x=(-b±√(b²-4ac))/(2a)，判别式决定根的个数。
光合作用的条件是光照、适宜的温度、水分和二氧化碳，场所是叶绿体，产物是有机物和氧气。
SQLite 的 WAL 模式将写入追加到预写日志，读写不再互相阻塞，读操作看到的是快照，写入性能和并发度都更高。
断点续传的实现依赖 HTTP Range 请求：客户端记录已下载字节数，重连时从 offset 继续拉取，服务端返回 206 部分内容。
在知识图谱上做拓扑排序可以把先修依赖转成学习顺序：每轮取出入度为零的知识点，删除其出边，重复直到所有节点输出。
余弦相似度等于两个向量点积除以模长的乘积，取值范围 -1 到 1，常用于衡量归一化后的语义向量方向一致性。
「康德拉季马奔腾」是网友对经济周期理论中长波周期的戏称，源自康德拉季耶夫周期，指长达五十到六十年的技术经济循环。
秦灭六国的顺序为韩、赵、魏、楚、燕、齐，公元前 221 年齐国降秦，秦王嬴政称始皇帝，建立郡县制。
When a BLE peripheral disconnects, the client should apply exponential backoff before reconnecting, cache the last known services, and avoid continuous scanning to save battery.
IVF indexes partition the vector space into clusters and probe only the nearest cells at query time, while HNSW builds a navigable small-world graph that routes greedily toward the query.
SQLite queries slow down as the database grows when lookups degenerate into full table scans; creating covering indexes on filter columns lets the engine answer from the index alone.

Text embeddings are trained so that semantically similar passages map to nearby points in vector space, which is why cosine similarity between embeddings reflects meaning overlap rather than token overlap.
OutOfMemoryError during batch inference usually means the batch size times the activation footprint exceeds the heap; reduce the batch, stream the inputs, or move tensors to a smaller dtype.
After truncating a Matryoshka embedding from 768 to 256 dimensions you must re-normalize the resulting vector so that dot products keep behaving like cosine similarity.
Structured concurrency in Kotlin ties child coroutines to a scope, so cancelling the scope cancels every child and errors propagate to the caller instead of leaking work.
A vector index must be rebuilt whenever the embedding model, its revision, the output dimension, or the prompt policy changes, because old vectors live in a different, incompatible space.
WorkManager 支持 LINEAR 或 EXPONENTIAL 退避策略，通过 setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) 配置重试间隔。
git merge 保留分支历史生成合并提交，git rebase 把当前提交线性地搬到目标分支之上，历史更干净但会改写提交哈希。
Gradle 依赖锁定：在 gradle dependencyLocking { lockAllConfigurations() } 后执行 ./gradlew dependencies --write-locks 生成 gradle.lockfile。
def clamp(v, lo, hi): return lo if v < lo else hi if v > hi else v  # python 三元表达式示例
